description.value: Starting at 3rd level, a red mage gains one ruby arcana, and an additional ruby arcana for every three levels of red mage attained after 3rd. Unless otherwise noted, a red mage cannot select a particular ruby arcana more than once. Ruby arcana that affect spells can only modify spells from the red mage spell list unless otherwise noted. A complete list of ruby arcana can be found in the Ruby Arcana compendium.
